Commentary.Commentary: We are back after the Lunch break! The Pakistani players make their way out to the middle. Kevin Kasuza and Tarisai Musakanda will open the innings. And Shaheen Afridi will start with the ball.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

Right then! That is all from the first session. The post Lunch session will see Zimbabwe come out to bat again as Pakistan have enforced the follow-on. Can they manage to put on a stronger performance in the next session? Join us in 40 minutes to find out!

Pakistan dominated with the ball as well. It started when the debutant, Tabish Khan, picked up the early wicket. Sajid Khan and Shaheen Afridi took a wicket each on Day 2 to tighten the screws. But the star with the ball was Hasan Ali, he took a wicket on Day 2 and 3 quick wickets early on Day 3. There was a decent partnership between Kaia and Tiripano that followed. But Sajid Khan dismissed Tiripano before Lunch and Hasan Ali came on to take the wicket of Kaia. In the end, a run out was what gave them the final wicket.

Zimbabwe needed someone to play an innings like Abid Ali but that did not happen. They lost their openers early and the middle order was exposed to the new ball. Brendan Taylor and Milton Shumba didn't last for long and were back in the hut on Day 2. The only player who looked good was Regis Chakabva. But on Day 3, he too fell to Hasan Ali. Luke Jongwe played a few good shots but he misjudged a ball and was bowled by Hasan Ali. Tiripano stitched a decent stand with Kaia but he fell just before Lunch and then Kaia fell soon after. The run out of Muzarabani was the final nail.

A session and an innings which was completely dominated by Pakistan. They have skittled out Zimbabwe for a low score and are well in control of the game. Zimbabwe have a mountain to climb if they want to get back in the game.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo is down by the pitchside, says that the pitch has dried up a bit and it will assist the spinners. Adds that the ball might stay a touch low.

Hello and welcome to Day 3 of the second Test between Pakistan and Zimbabwe. The visitors are in total control of this game. They have a chance of bundling the hosts for yet another low score and then enforce the follow-on. Will they do so is remained to be seen. The home side on the other need massive efforts from their batters if they are to avoid the follow on. Can some character be shown by them? We’ll find out.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

They still trail by more than 450 runs and they need a monumental effort from a few batters even if they are to avoid the follow-on. Pakistan, on the other hand, will hope for more of the same. Do join us for Day 3 as the action will begin at 0930 local (0730 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care.
After declaring just after Tea, their bowlers got into the act. 4 out of the 5 bowlers got a wicket which sees Zimbabwe well behind the 8-ball game.

Slightly fuller, but still around the off pole. Regis offers a solid defense.
Length around off, tapped to the leg side.
On a good length, around off, Kasuza pushes this to covers.
Kevin Kasuza has just blocked that from his crease.
Around off, pushed to mid on.
On the pads, Kevin misses his flick but the ball takes the pad and goes through square leg for a couple of leg byes.
On middle, kept out.
Outside off, Kevin does not want to play at this.
Good length on off, this is stroked through covers for one.

POKE AND A MISS! A good length delivery around off, Kevin Kasuza lets his bat hang and at the last moment, he pulls his bat back. The ball goes to Rizwan, and he appeals. Nothing from the umpire though.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
Outside off, the ball seams away again, but Kevin Kasuza does not want to risk it. Leaves it be.
FOUR BYES. Tabish looks to bowl a fuller ball, but bowls it down the leg side. Mohammad Rizwan dives to his left but is not able to stop it. The ball runs away to the ropes.
Hits the deck hard around off, Kevin pushes it towards covers.
On the off pole, Regis plays this towards point.
A short of a length ball around off, Regis Chakabva hops and offers a defensive stroke, to the off side.
Around off, defended out again.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
Around off, tapped through point for a single.
Fuller outside off, KK leaves.
Outside off, no shot offered.

EDGY FOUR! Gets the ball to shape away, yet again, does Tabish Khan. A good length ball on off, Regis Chakabva looks to whip this one to the leg side but the ball takes the outside edge and runs away through short third man for a boundary.
Outside off, slight shape away this time, Regis Chakabva raises his willow and makes a leave.
Around off, Regis taps it towards point.
Fuller again, but outside off. RC leaves.
Fuller on off, this is kept out.
Outside off, left alone.
This one keeps very low after landing outside off. Kasuza lets it be.
Outside off, left alone.
And again, the angle causes problems. On off and slanting away. It goes past the outsid edge as Kasuza tries to block.
BEATEN! Length and on off, angling away. Kasuza is beaten as he tries to block.
WIDE! That is very wide outside off, Rizwan takes it with a dive to his right.
A good short one, Kasuza does well to drop his hands and let it go to the keeper.
Who comes out now? It is Regis Chakabva!

OUT! LBW! What a moment for Tabish Khan and Pakistan have struck very early here. First Test wicket for Khan and he will be very glad, that it has come in his first over here! He bowls five balls, which are nipping away from the right-hander, then the next ball, he gets it to nip back into the right-hander and Tarisai Musakanda misses his flick away to the leg side. Gets struck on the pad. A very loud appeal and the umpire takes his time, but then, he raises his finger. Big moment for Khan and this is just the start that Pakistan were looking for!
Around off, pushed to point.
Outside off, but TM's punch only finds the cover fielder.
Around middle, nudged to the leg side.
Outside off, stroked to covers.
A length ball, outside off, the ball moves away as Tarisai Musakanda looks to have a poke. He gets beaten though.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Tabish Khan!
Maiden! A length ball around off, Kevin blocks this out.
Outside off, left alone by Kevin.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Kasuza hops and defends it to cover.
Good length ball down the middle, Kasuza puches it back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, KK misses his flick away.
We are back for Zimbabwe's first innings! The openers for Zimbabwe, Kevin Kasuza and Tarisai Musakanda come out. Shaheen Afridi will open the proceedings with the ball.
Length ball but way outside off, Kevin Kasuza leaves this be.
